# revpiper

revpiper takes a systematic review team from extracted data to
manuscript-ready tables and figures, driven by specifications you author
— a data dictionary describing your extraction files, declared assembly
and cleaning, audited manual corrections, and a re-runnable derivation
layer — rather than code you write.

**Status: pre-alpha.** The design is documented in
[`dev/superpowers/specs/`](https://lizspry.github.io/revpiper/dev/superpowers/specs/);
implementation is in progress and nothing here is usable yet.

## Installation

Not yet installable. Watch this space.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`rev_spec_audit()`](https://lizspry.github.io/revpiper/reference/rev_spec_audit.md)
  : Audit the spec step
- [`rev_spec_run()`](https://lizspry.github.io/revpiper/reference/rev_spec_run.md)
  : Run the spec step
